verdict.rationale: Google Cloud ships the official `gcloud` CLI. First-party docs cover installation and initialization, including a curl installer, and describe a full command reference for authentication, configuration, developer workflow and interacting with Google Cloud APIs. Community material shows real hands-on use of `gcloud` commands. Missing for 10: documentation of AI/agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive agent workflows, and independent corroboration of the CLI's quality for AI-native use.
